comment: Third-party binaries fetched into deps/ by scripts/fetch-deps.ps1, never committed. Each download is pinned by SHA256 (GitHub publishes a digest for every release asset). Change a version here, then run the script and the tests. 'notices' names every file the installer ships from deps/ and its licences (paths from the repository root); scripts/write-notices.ps1 refuses a file that has none. docs/adr/0008-pdf-engines-pdfium-and-qpdf.md

notices.title: PDFium chromium/8100, as built by bblanchon/pdfium-binaries
notices.note: pdfium.dll contains PDFium and the libraries whose licences follow LICENSE, the licence of the build scripts.

notices.title: zlib 1.3.2, linked into qpdf30.dll
notices.note: The licence text is the copy pdfium-binaries ships for its own zlib; zlib's licence is the same in every version.

notices.title: libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0, linked into qpdf30.dll
notices.note: This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group. The licence texts are the copies pdfium-binaries ships for its own libjpeg-turbo, under the same licences.

notices.title: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime 14.51, shipped with qpdf 12.4.2
